arguments.html:
SI05 / SI06 · P4 / P5
C · Independent company confirmation
USER JOB
Show whether the group supports the company independently of its own move.
OWNER / SOURCE
prophet_early_leadership_evidence; leadership_rotation_context.dedupe_source_roots; residual_alpha owner.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Raw group + leave-issuer-out group; all same-issuer aliases; excluded weight; source roots; peer method and window.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Current residual_alpha sector mean includes the candidate. Add a qualified adaptation; preserve incumbent behavior.
INTERACTION
Name Setup → peer membership → raw versus issuer-excluded view → company evidence.
STATES
Singleton/concentrated groups may have no independent support. A residual is not automatically alpha.
PROOF
SP04 / SP05 / SP06: perturb issuer/aliases and duplicate roots; independent confirmation must not improve.
CUSTODY
P4 source adaptation, P5 accepted evaluation. No browser score or repeated evidence votes.
SI07 · P4
D · Two-way evidence, no circular signal
USER JOB
Return company economics and contradictions to the sector workspace.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing group/member/earnings producers and their original source-qualified observations.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Complete dated reporting cohort, issuer dedupe, fiscal period, published/available time, reported/usable/unknown counts, revisions.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Selected Prophet winners, ranks and popularity are not independent sector economics or institutional flow.
INTERACTION
Sector evidence → constituent observation → Prophet dossier → exact sector return.
STATES
Unreported is unknown; source correction retains original-known view. Price/volume proxy is labeled as a proxy.
PROOF
SP05 / SP12: selection changes do not alter the underlying economic aggregate; missing reports stay unknown.
CUSTODY
Sector lanes 5 / 7 / 8 + P4. Outcomes return only to existing Evaluation.

arguments.html:
SI12 / SI16 · P5
I · Prove beta before claiming alpha
USER JOB
Measure market participation, sector allocation and within-sector selection as separate jobs.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing Evaluation protocols; original Q01–Q24; no new registry or protected-outcome permission.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Frozen PIT universe/benchmark, cost/fill/channel model, risk/capital, horizon, availability, selection history and acceptance margin.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Compare passive market, simple participation, sector-only, member-only, joint, incumbent and independent emergence.
INTERACTION
Strategy evaluation → comparator → missed opportunity → original eligible decision/source.
STATES
Unsupported historical features narrow the claim. Null, inconclusive, blocked, killed and not evaluated remain distinct.
PROOF
SP19 / SP21 / SP22: cost/exposure matching, rebound failure and no-fill/delisted cases remain in evaluation.
CUSTODY
Sector lane 8; P5 owner admission. No universal Sharpe threshold or presumed safety/news-timing causality.
SI13 / SI14 · P6
J · Separate strategy evaluation from Plan Record
USER JOB
Show participation and attribution without inventing holdings from research or plan outcomes.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing Evaluation result adapter; actual Portfolio/Risk and factor_exposure. Original Record contract remains closed.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Qualified result/protocol; actual or simulated weights/capital/cash; benchmark; period; costs/FX; attribution method/coverage.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Preserve MODEL_PLAN_RECORD | REGISTERED_OPPORTUNITY_COHORT. Strategy evaluation is an explicit compatible adapter/view.
INTERACTION
Record → Strategy evaluation → benchmark/attribution source; actual Portfolio is a distinct authorized view.
STATES
Missing holdings/weights withholds reconciliation. HK/CN/CA native factor coverage cannot inherit the US-clock model.
PROOF
SP19 / SP20: cash + allocation + selection + interaction + costs reconcile; near-zero denominators never fabricate capture.
CUSTODY
SX05 is partial: its attribution edit has unknown effect on root 1G21-0 / target 1G3F-0. Do not duplicate or finish that subtree.

arguments.html:
SI15 · P6
K · Follow meaningful sector changes
USER JOB
Notify a user when the retained sector/issuer context materially changes.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing semantic transition producer, preference/enrollment, B21 outbox/channel and delivery receipt owner.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Original/current context refs; event kind/version; correction/retraction link; subscription/category/list; account; delivery state.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
A saved preference is not an active producer or delivered notification. Poll churn and quote restamps are not events.
INTERACTION
Follow changes → explicit preferences → confirmed capability → source-linked change → exact research return.
STATES
Producer unavailable: preference retained, capability honestly unavailable. Corrections dedupe against original event.
PROOF
SP17 / SP18: unchanged refresh sends nothing; one material correction yields one qualified event; delivery proved separately.
CUSTODY
No second queue, watcher, notification truth store or automatic enrollment.
SI18 / SI19 / SI20 · P7
L · Production proof, custody and rollback
USER JOB
Prove the connected path works under ordinary refresh, corrections, failures and account changes.
OWNER / SOURCE
Existing generation/auth/telemetry/release owners, live Sector lane custody and original PF01–PF20.
INPUTS / IDENTITY
Exact source/head/build/served-generation evidence; entitlements; real consumer; correction/failure cases; compatible rollback.
CALCULATION / CLAIM
Paper, authored protocols and green CI do not establish installed behavior, accepted science or production readiness.
INTERACTION
First real slice: native Sector context → complete Prophet population → company Setup → retained source → exact return.
